Name: Emily sells clothing at the Oasis
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
This mod expands the Oasis (Sandy's) shop to include additional clothing and supplies. Would you like Emily's Magic Outfit but don't want to marry her? What about the living hat or the unobtainable coy boy boots? Now you can buy them.

Two ways to get to Emily's shop. Inside from the Oasis (bottom left corner) and/or outside. 

Emily has the supplies needed to make clothes and she mentions how she enjoys making clothes. With Emily and Sandy being friends, it makes sense for Emily to sell clothes and related supplies at the Oasis. There are 2 new hats and 2 new shirts for sale. Each shirt for sale is only obtained during character creation. 

There is optional dialogue changes for Emily, Sandy and Haley to reflect this change.  You can choose if you want Emily to visit the Oasis Saturday, Sunday and Monday. 

You can choose which group of items you want to include.
